system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
No hulu anymore randomly. Hulu said they can't do anything & it's on ur end. Help forums on your site said to talk via here?

PREDICTED INTENT: subscription_manage

PRECEDENTS:

[1280143] (similarity 0.41, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: Ever since Roku had their latest upgrade Spotify doesn't work. I can see both of my accounts but I can't get into them.
  spotify replied: Hey Steve! We're changing the availability of our apps on some TVs. You can find more info here: <link>

[2513135] (similarity 0.72, intent login_access)
  past customer: I am having difficulty logging into Hulu and they said to contact you.
  spotify replied: Hey Haley! Help's arrived. Just to check, are you trying to sign up for the Student Discount + Hulu bundle? If you're receiving an error message, sending us a screenshot would be super useful

[747175] (similarity 0.72, intent other)
  past customer: & what the hells going on with my hulu account??? it just suddenly stops working….
  spotify replied: Hi, help's here! We suggest that you contact Hulu here: <link> for more info. They'll get to the bottom of this

[2158631] (similarity 0.64, intent other)
  past customer: can you fix my Hulu account bc I'm in the middle of a show. I'd appreciate it.
  spotify replied: Hey there! Can you let us know what's happening exactly? We'll see what we can suggest

[1694973] (similarity 0.63, intent other)
  past customer: Just signed up for spotify premium + hulu and I can't activate hulu because I can not load up the web page :(
  spotify replied: Hey! Don't worry, we're on it. Our developers are looking into this, and we'll keep everyone updated
